digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate LLM step failure telemetry
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step call failures in review-plan runs are invisible to callers: failed steps swallow errors and return abstain/degrade, leaving no counter in the plan-review verdict JSON to distinguish a silent failure from a legitimate empty result.

Failed LLM calls across ~13 swallow sites in src/rebar/llm/ (overlap judge, xcheck, completion_subcall, novelty, ISF summarization, code_review, epic_bug_screen, etc.) each log a warning but contribute nothing to the verdict coverage object, and the single seam PydanticAIRunner.run:573 writes only to a JSONL spend log, never to in-memory verdict state.

A new run-scoped contextvars-based sink in src/rebar/llm/step_failures.py records failed LLM calls at the runner seam, is activated in the plan-review run scope, and drains into a new coverage.llm_step_failures field shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<call_label>: <int>}}, present only when non-empty to maintain attestation safety.

The failure counter must not alter the verdict string, exit code, signature, provenance, or swallow behaviour of any existing LLM step; it is observability only and applies to plan-review runs exclusively.
